mergeRule: Join localized feed rows by game + service + iInfoId. Different languages do not imply separate gameplay servers. hoyolab.note: post.structured_content contains official locale text. post.multi_language_info includes official translated titles. This is official multilingual content, not automatic GoogleTranslate output. Use is_multi_language + author verification; do not trust arbitrary HoYoLAB community posts.

global.languageVersions: Korean/Japanese notice pages are localized versions of the same Global/Asia schedule. Do not create KR and JP gameplay servers from language variants.
global.otherRegions: America, Europe, TW/HK/MO may be exposed later only after schedule handling is verified. Current entries are Asia only.
